recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated trio portrait set against a chaotic, distressed white background featuring heavy ink splatters, yellow caution tape elements, and bold, layered typography in gold and black.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject trio anchored in the lower two-thirds of the frame
Gold accents in jewelry and text contrasting against monochrome figures
Aggressive ink splatter textures framing the top and sides
Caution tape motifs creating horizontal breaks in the composition
coreInvariants: Desaturated skin tones with high-contrast lighting
Heavy black ink splatter and drip textures
Gold-to-yellow gradient on primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures positioned side-by-side, waist-up, filling the horizontal width of the lower half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure and the large, stylized gold title text directly above them.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-center title down to the central figure, then outward to the flanking figures and the caution tape at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Upper corners and central background are white but filled with 'noise' like splatters and grit.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and black provide the high-contrast foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in clothing and ink splatters create depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold and caution-tape yellow provide focal points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation for subjects; high value contrast; high saturation only for gold/yellow accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and thick sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick, blocky letterforms with a slight vertical stretch
Secondary title elements use hand-drawn, gestural brush strokes
Metadata text uses clean, wide-tracked sans-serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: First word of title features a circular 'O' crossed out with a thick, expressive brush stroke
Roman numerals are rendered as solid, heavy vertical blocks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive brush-lettering paired with clean, authoritative block fonts.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the block text.
To replicate the gestural, hand-painted 'NO' element.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, high-contrast urban background with white distressed paper texture, black ink splatters, and yellow caution tape at the bottom. Place three desaturated, high-contrast male figures in streetwear and gold jewelry in the foreground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, gold-gradient block text with black outlines at the top center. Incorporate a hand-drawn brush-stroke 'NO' symbol to the left of the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the gold gradient consistent across all text elements?
Are the figures desaturated enough to look nearly black and white?
Does the ink splatter feel organic and messy rather than a clean pattern?
Is the caution tape distressed and partially obscured?

adjustableVariables: Amount of gold jewelry on subjects
Level of desaturation on the figures
mustRedesign: Parental advisory sticker (use generic version if needed)
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast balance between black and white areas
Ensure gold text is legible against the splatter
Verify the 'grunge' texture is visible on the background
Confirm the trio arrangement is balanced but not perfectly symmetrical
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast desaturated subjects + heavy ink splatter background + bold gold-gradient outlined typography + caution tape accents.
